note: Demonstration settings. Every value here is illustrative and waits for the committee (Appendix B). The website reads it through the same contracts the live system will use, so replacing this file does not change the interface.

schedule.turnSource: Club rule poster: 9 holes take 2 hours 15 minutes

sessions.source: Twilight poster: tee times 14:45 to 15:15; on the half-hour grid that is the 15:00 start

schedule.intervalNote: Tee times every 30 minutes, on the hour and half hour (client request, 18 Nov 2026)
schedule.horizonNote: Phase 2 demo horizon (20 Nov 2026): 60 calendar dates including Bangkok today, offsets 0 to 59. A shorter value here shortens the calendar, the tee sheet and the service check together.

holidays.note: Demo holiday list. Confirm against the club's calendar.

deposit.source: Visitor package poster: 'A booking deposit of THB 500 will be credited toward your green fee'. Per-golfer basis is our assumption.

tiers.source: The THB 500 amount is from the club poster. Applying it per golfer, and only up to 7 days ahead, is part of the demo.

tiers.assumption: O2 demo assumption (Phase 2 brief, 20 Nov 2026): THB 250 per golfer for tee dates more than seven Bangkok calendar days after the day the hold is made. Not a club rule.

deposit.leadRule: Lead time is the number of Bangkok calendar days from the day the hold is created to the tee date. Day 7 uses the standard deposit; day 8 and later use the advance deposit.
